messages:
anya: Drafted announcement copy for the new per-route token insights + rollout controls. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4720. Need tiny SDK snippet swaps (Node + Py) and a known-issues blurb.
tom: I can take Node. Which folder?
anya: `docs/examples/sdk/v2/node/` and the page at `docs/content/notes/2025-10-route-insights.md`. Node still uses `client.generate()` in a few spots 1 -> migrate to `client.chat.create()` and update stream example.
lee: I'll do Python snippets and add a snippet-runner test. Proposed known issue: streaming may cut off with very long system prompts; workaround: shorten prompt or set `max_system_tokens` client-side.
deploy-bot: Netlify preview: https://deploy-preview-814--docs.redwood.ai 1 build passed but 1 broken anchor `#streaming-limits` found.	anya: I'll add the anchor and small redirect fix in a follow-up PR. Keep snippet PRs separate so we can cherry-pick to maintenance. Target publish: Tue.
